The policy excerpts include DOC-044 parts 1-3 about sharing a dashboard without login: any dashboard can be shared as a read-only public link from Share menu, no login required; link stays live and updates in real time; sharing can be revoked anytime.

Thus we can answer: Yes, you can share a read-only public link via Share menu; it updates live; you can revoke anytime.
